notes.title: July 24 -- Update
notes.content:
It's been 4 months since Hydroplane: Riptide Racers released! Thanks everyone for supporting and reviewing the game!

With this update, we're adding some quality of life enhances, general bug fixes, and some balancing to items. 

[list]
[*] Frost Field size reduced
[*] Decreased chance for AI racers to get rockets
[*] Fixed several sound effects that weren't triggering or weren't loud enough to hear
[*] Mag Harpoon now attaches to mines as well as other racers
[*] Speed adjustments on AI racers
[*] Rocket pathing fixed
[*] Rearview camera added to left mouse click or top button on a controller
[*] Race finished screen changed
[/list]

Thanks again everyone!
